title: When the Group Chat Breaks
author: Kestrel Coldharbour
blurb: Ines Ashgrove, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, has spent fifteen years being so careful it hurts. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
